decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a quick combo using Tinker to search for Phyrexian Devourer and then sacrificing it with Fling to deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent. The deck also includes various mana acceleration and card draw spells to support the combo, while also running cards like Defense Grid and Tsabo's Web to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base consists of fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors to power out the combo pieces quickly.

This aggressive Elf deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Tangle Wire and Plow Under. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent by quickly getting out powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Skyshroud Poacher, effectively controlling the board with cards like Rishadan Port. With an emphasis on speed and disruption, this deck looks to quickly build a strong board presence and maintain control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources while gradually wearing them down with discard spells, removal, and efficient creatures. The deck aims to establish board control and card advantage through cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, Smother, and The Rack. The inclusion of cards like Ravenous Rats and Tempting Wurm provide additional pressure on the opponent while cards like Sylvan Library and Graveborn Muse help maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game state and grinding out a victory through attrition.

The deck focuses on playing powerful creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and using Stifle to counter any attempt to stop their abilities. The player also uses card draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Impulse to find key combo pieces quickly. Protection is provided through counterspells like Counterspell and Foil, while also having bounce spells like Chain of Vapor to deal with threats. The mana base is streamlined with mostly Islands and Mishra's Factory to ensure the player has the right colors for their spells.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the game using cycling cards to draw and cycle through the deck efficiently while disrupting the opponent's strategies. By utilizing cards like Eternal Dragon, Lightning Rift, and Astral Slide, the deck aims to maintain board control and gain incremental advantages over time. The inclusion of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God allows the deck to deal with threats while also cycling through the deck to find key pieces for the win condition. Overall, the deck focuses on resource management and maintaining control throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing small, efficient creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By sacrificing creatures and using cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand, it aims to establish board control and pressure the opponent's life total. With access to powerful removal spells like Snuff Out and Smother, as well as mana denial cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while steadily advancing its own game plan.

The central focus of this Mono Blue Storm deck is to efficiently generate mana and draw cards in order to assemble a powerful combo involving Lion's Eye Diamond and Brain Freeze. By utilizing cards like Cloud of Faeries, Sapphire Medallion, and Helm of Awakening to reduce costs and generate mana, the deck aims to cast a large amount of spells in a single turn to mill the opponent's library with Brain Freeze. The deck is designed to chain together spells and combo pieces quickly to overwhelm the opponent before they can effectively respond.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board by ramping up mana quickly with Mox Diamond and utilizing disruptive spells like Sphere of Resistance. The deck aims to use Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore and overwhelm the opponent. It also includes removal spells like Naturalize and board wipes like Pyroclasm to maintain board control. The land base consists of various utility lands and mana sources to ensure smooth gameplay and consistent mana production. Ultimately, the deck strives to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, Vindicate, and Gerrard's Verdict to deal with threats on the board. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Exalted Angel and Eternal Dragon to close out games. With a mix of hand disruption, removal, and powerful creatures, this BW Control deck aims to outlast the opponent and take control of the game. Additionally, cards like Phyrexian Furnace and Dust Bowl provide additional utility and disruption for the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana through various Elf creatures and support cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle, allowing for powerful plays early in the game. By utilizing Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent with cards like Tangle Wire and Rishadan Port. Overall, this deck excels at overwhelming opponents with aggressive plays and efficient mana production.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence through efficient control spells and creatures that grow in power. It utilizes a mix of countermagic, card draw, and disruptive elements like Winter Orb to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes evasive threats like Mystic Enforcer and Quirion Dryad to apply pressure and close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently locked down. City of Brass and Mox Diamond provide mana acceleration to help cast spells quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on playing highly efficient and aggressive red creatures and burn spells to deal damage as quickly as possible to the opponent. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of damage and pressure, while using cards like Grim Lavamancer and Cursed Scroll for additional reach. Cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Price of Progress punish opponents for playing slower decks or relying on non-basic lands. With a low mana curve and high amount of burn, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

Utilizing a combination of resource denial and card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue opponents by controlling the game with Winter Orb and Opposition while leveraging the card selection of Sylvan Library. Survival of the Fittest acts as a toolbox for finding key creatures like Deranged Hermit and Gilded Drake, while creatures like Spike Feeder and Mystic Snake provide additional utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's diverse mana requirements, allowing for consistent access to powerful card interactions and ultimately grinding opponents out of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Call of the Herd, Wild Mongrel, and Tireless Tribe to create a powerful creature army while using cards like Circular Logic and Meddling Mage to control the opponent's plays. The deck also features a graveyard recursion strategy with cards like Deep Analysis and Roar of the Wurm. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately leading to a victory through a combination of aggression and control.

The core idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy focused on efficiently utilizing white creatures and disruptive spells. By deploying low-cost creatures like Silver Knight and Glowrider alongside powerful angels like Exalted Angel, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence. The inclusion of cards like Armageddon and Cataclysm further disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Parallax Wave and Seal of Cleansing provide additional utility and removal options. This deck is designed to attack quickly and decisively to secure victory.
